description: This file defines a Perl module for a script that allows setting a new password for a user in the Coocook application. It includes methods for prompting the user, validating input, and updating the password in the database.

classes.name: Coocook::Script::Passwd
classes.description: A Perl class implementing a script to change user passwords within the Coocook system.

methods.description: Main method to execute the password change process, including user lookup, password input, validation, and update.
